stage: frozen after blind negative-control calibration and before candidate inspection

probes.construction: Packed material codes 0..3, roughness endpoints and arbitrary RGBA alpha payloads; OFF and enabled sidecar executions.
probes.gate: Input arrays and native meaning remain identical; diagnostic implementation does not remap IDs, roughness, normal or alpha.

probes.construction: A rigid plane with known full-render UV motion and different current/previous crop origins, plus a variant with motion bringing every history position outside the prior crop.
probes.gate: Validity must follow render-coordinate transport. No clipping an out-of-crop sample into valid history.

probes.construction: A first frame without a predecessor and a frame whose guide, depth or MV includes nonfinite values.
probes.gate: Unsupported evidence is explicitly invalid; a consumer cannot interpret an unobserved agreement as high-confidence history.

probes.construction: Two different hidden coverage/lighting mixtures producing the same available normal, depth, material and MV arrays.
probes.gate: Candidate diagnostics are identical, demonstrating they cannot identify hidden coverage or physical correctness. Truth may not leak into candidate observables.

probes.construction: Identical guides/chronology with independent Gaussian noise, correlated sparse noise, and a noiseless moderate true-light step.
probes.gate: A guide-only sidecar is identical across these lighting interventions and cannot claim to diagnose or solve their distinct output flicker.

probes.construction: Static and moving rigid relief, curved surfaces and window frames with valid angular/depth variation.
probes.gate: Guide variation must not become a semantic foliage label. Downgrades on valid rigid detail must be reported as potential false positives.

probes.construction: Homogeneous known normals, octahedral hemisphere/seam cases and equal angular patterns under global rotations.
probes.gate: Proper decode error is separate from representation uncertainty. A deliberately misdecoded variant must be caught by an appropriate control.

probes.construction: A destructive smoother and a sidecar identity result on the same analytic and BASE masks.
probes.gate: Metrics retain the same sample masks and numerical denominators, and the known destructive control fails the detail gate.
